summary: Feed s061_single to IDS is degraded: 8.3% TCP packet loss (136/1636 packets) exceeds 1% threshold. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLAN, encryption, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream capture loss - SPAN/mirror port oversubscription or packet broker buffer exhaustion dropping packets before IDS. Tool overload check is healthy, so loss is not at IDS ingress policing but at the SPAN/broker aggregation layer where bursty traffic exceeds 1Gbps port capacity or buffer.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both directions and full payload for stream reassembly. With 8.3% missing TCP segments, IDS cannot reliably reassemble flows, misses exploit payloads, allows evasion via dropped segments, and generates incomplete alerts/false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: SPAN/mirror drops packets under load by design; passive TAP provides lossless, line-rate copy to packet broker. Replace SPAN with TAP at the source and ensure broker-to-tool links are not oversubscribed (add load_balance or filter if aggregate still >1Gbps).
